candidate.rationale: Documented current color treatment (red→orange→teal gradient circle) for the unchanged monogram geometry; official mkb.ru asset. Vector reconstruction planned from baseline geometry with gradient fill because the only public asset is raster.

The baseline predates this color treatment.
